comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request, the exit code of a network error, the mock's answer to that request (by path, under --base-url http://mock:8080; the portal's paths start with /api/v1), and a string the printed answer contains. The answer is the first two schemas of a live search for Hundesteuer, recorded on 2026-11-19 and cut.
